_comment: UI feature schema for the Neuro-Screen assessment. 'model_column' is the EXACT raw survey-question column name from the training CSV (Thesis Dataset.csv / Thesis3.ipynb). Option strings are the exact category vocabulary the trained model learned (post encoding-fix: ASCII hyphens like '1-2', '5-6 hours'). The training script validates these against the real dataset and writes data/feature_schema.generated.json with the authoritative column names.

features.label: Age
features.description: Your current age in years.
features.model_column: What is your age?

features.label: Gender
features.description: The gender you identify with.
features.model_column: What is your gender?

features.label: University
features.description: The university you are currently studying at.
features.model_column: What is your University name?

features.label: Academic Year
features.description: Your current year of study at university.
features.model_column: Your current year of study?

features.label: Average Sleep Hours
features.description: How many hours of actual sleep you get on a typical night.
features.model_column: On average, how many hours of actual sleep do you get per night?

features.label: Overall Sleep Quality
features.description: How well you feel you sleep overall.
features.model_column: How would you rate your overall sleep quality?

features.label: Nightly Awakenings
features.description: How often you wake up in the middle of the night.
features.model_column: How often do you wake up in the middle of the night?

features.label: Daily Caffeine Intake
features.description: How many cups of caffeine (tea/coffee/energy drinks) you have daily.
features.recommended: Limit to 1-2 cups before the afternoon
features.model_column: How many cups of caffeine (tea/coffee/energy drinks) do you have daily?

features.label: Bedtime Device Use
features.description: How often you use electronic devices (phone/laptop) in bed before sleep.
features.model_column: How often do you use electronic devices (phone/laptop) in bed before sleep?

features.label: Cognitive Load
features.description: How often you feel cognitive load during the day.
features.model_column: How often do you feel cognitive load?

features.label: Stress Frequency
features.description: How often you feel stressed in your daily academic life.
features.model_column: How often do you feel stressed?

features.label: Mental / Physical Fatigue
features.description: How often physical or mental fatigue prevents you from completing your daily goals.
features.model_column: How often does physical or mental fatigue prevent you from completing your daily goals?

features.label: Sleep Impact on GPA
features.description: To what extent you feel sleep deprivation is lowering your GPA.
features.model_column: To what extent do you feel sleep deprivation is lowering your GPA?

features.label: Missed Deadlines
features.description: How many academic deadlines you have missed or delayed in the last month.
features.model_column: How many academic deadlines have you missed or delayed in the last month?

features.label: Mental Stamina
features.description: Your ability to think hard for long periods of time.
features.model_column: How would you rate your "Mental Stamina" (the ability to think hard for long periods)?

features.label: Spacing Out
features.description: How often you find yourself spacing out or losing your train of thought during conversations.
features.model_column: How often do you find yourself "spacing out" or losing your train of thought during conversations?

features.label: Audio Lag
features.description: Whether you hear someone speak but take a few seconds to understand the meaning.
features.model_column: Do you experience "Audio Lag" (hearing someone speak but taking a few seconds to understand the meaning)?

features.label: Forgetting Daily Information
features.description: How often you forget basic information in your daily life.
features.model_column: How often do you forget basic information in your daily life?

features.label: Reminder Reliance
features.description: How much you rely on external reminders (alarms, notes, friends) to remember basic daily tasks.
features.model_column: How much do you rely on "external reminders" (alarms, notes, friends) to remember basic daily tasks?

features.label: Brain Fog
features.description: How frequently you experience confusion or lack of mental clarity.
features.model_column: How frequently do you experience "Brain Fog" (confusion or lack of clarity)?

features.label: Decision-Making Difficulty
features.description: Whether you struggle with making quick decisions or solving logical problems.
features.model_column: Do you struggle with making quick decisions or solving logical problems?
